# Rookstride

> An independent, open-source Android app for deploying and managing a single-VPS strongSwan IKEv2 VPN with AdGuard Home and Unbound. Your VPS. Your way.

Early alpha: 0.1.0-alpha2, updated 2026-10-14. Android 8+; fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VPS. Phone network access and administrator SSH are required. No cloud account or public management API.

## Practical documentation
- [Setup and connection](/start/): Administrator installation and invited strongSwan users; key verification, filtering, troubleshooting and reset.
- [Routes](/routes/): Implemented experimental IKEv2 → AmneziaWG pair with its own guide/evidence; in the published 0.2.0-alpha2 prerelease; the earlier 0.1.0-alpha2 APK is single-server. Additional engines remain proposals.
- [Full research](/docs/universal-gateway-research.md): Source audit, compatibility, recovery and acceptance gates.
- [Infrastructure](/architecture/): VPN, private DNS, pinned SSH and optional local usage estimates.
- [Download and exact test status](/download/): Signed APK, source, checksums and remaining gates.
- [Open source and privacy](/open-source/): Repositories, licenses, contribution and original brand.
- [Expanded project reference](/llms-full.txt): Plain-text facts and limitations.

## Release evidence
- [Route research manifest](/data/routes.json): Released single-server capabilities, experimental pair capabilities and proposed additional engines.
- [Earlier single-server manifest](/data/release.json): Frozen 0.1.0-alpha2 artifacts and identity.
- [Current verified artifacts](/data/current-release.json): Published APK, full source, hashes, sizes and precise test scope.
- [Current UI evidence](/data/ui-alpha3-tests.json): Exact signed APK checks on Android 8 and 9; transport/voice fixtures and remaining gates.
- [Current app](https://github.com/VictorBoykoV/rookstride/releases/tag/v0.2.0-alpha3): One- or two-server installation, persistent progress, offline worlds, page turns and optional device narration. Current UI test scope is in docs/UI-ALPHA3-TESTING.md; earlier server evidence is identified separately.
- [Sanitized test results](/data/alpha2-tests.json): Three signed-APK emulator/VPS reset-and-reinstall cycles.
- [Published pair artifacts](/data/pair-release.json): Verified 0.2.0-alpha2 APK, corresponding source, sizes and hashes.
- [Provider pair evidence](/data/pair-provider-alpha2-tests.json): Repeated app-configured two-provider pairs; exact Android/Linux client networks, reset/reboot checks and remaining gates.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/VictorBoykoV/rookstride): Authoritative implementation and build documentation.
- [Gateway repository](https://github.com/VictorBoykoV/single-vps-vpn-gateway): Server template and CLI deployment.

## Original fiction
- [Rook’s illustrated journal](/journal/): Five original comic chapters with panel, page and whole-chapter modes and animated page turns.
- [Complete text edition](/journal/text/): Every scene and dialogue line, accessible without scripts.

Important boundaries: IPv4 exit only; IPv6 is intentionally sunk. Rookstride’s own administration traffic is exempt. Android lockdown while disconnected is a separate OS setting. DNS filtering cannot reliably remove YouTube in-video ads. Per-device EAP logins are not hardware-bound. Usage totals are estimates, not billing. Reset deletes recognized gateway data, not Ubuntu or unrelated files. No guaranteed anonymity, website access or location change.

## Rook’s expanded original fiction
- [Five worlds, fifty complete chapters](/worlds/): Each chapter has four narrated story pages and a static readable URL. Optional device narration advances pages within a chapter and stops at its end.
- [Rook’s origin and values](/rook/): The original project ambassador, his story and guiding values.
- [Cultural source notes](/worlds/notes/): Real-world inspiration separated from original fiction.
- [Story source manifest](/data/worlds.json): Complete world, chapter, scene and narration data.
